8-2. Visitor from the Sky

Synopsis

Suzuki, an adult programmer, suddenly notice that he's thrown into another world wearing a casual clothes at level 1. He gained high level and treasures after using the 3-times-disposable-magic, Meteor Shower, once. After that he intend to do another world "sightseeing tours"?

Meeting 3 beast girls, beautiful purple and black haired sisters and an eccentric blond haired elf girl along with various people during his trip. Although occasionally fighting demon and demon lord, this is a heartwarming fantasy story at heart.

So here I am, trawling along through the series thinking "Wow, this is pretty damn nice." At least, I was thinking that until I hit this arc.

While some characters are admittedly annoying or grating (hello, sister!), Rihoko easily takes the cake (and then eats it). Her attitude of learned helplessness, general sense of ennui, and a desire to do more than just wish for change really made this arc exceedingly painful to the point that I contemplated completely skipping it... after only the first episode of this arc.

As a result, this arc is forever banned from my replay list, and I do not ever advise anyone who wants to watch the show to EVER watch this four episodes. Consider this your Naruto filler arc, or a "lost" arc and watch it at the end if you must. Either that, or bring this disc along when you're doing a painful watching session with friends.
